# cloider_cluster (Resource)

A managed Kubernetes cluster. Creating one waits until it is `Ready`. There is no rename or upgrade, so changing `name` or `version` replaces the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloider_cluster" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

# Deploy into it with the kubernetes and helm providers
provider "kubernetes" {
  host                   = cloider_cluster.web.kube_config.host
  cluster_ca_certificate = cloider_cluster.web.kube_config.cluster_ca_certificate
  client_certificate     = cloider_cluster.web.kube_config.client_certificate
  client_key             = cloider_cluster.web.kube_config.client_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The cluster's name: lower case letters, digits and `-`, starting with a letter. Names don't have to be unique, the dashboard tells clusters of the same name apart by `label`.

### Optional

- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is paused. A paused cluster keeps its state and isn't billed for compute. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `version` (String) The Kubernetes version, one of `cloider_options`' `cluster_versions`. Defaults to the newest offered.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the cluster was created, RFC 3339.
- `id` (String) The cluster's id.
- `kube_config` (Attributes, Sensitive) How to reach the cluster's Kubernetes api, for the `kubernetes` and `helm` providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kube_config))
- `label` (String) The name the dashboard shows, `name` with a `-1`, `-2`... suffix when another cluster has it.
- `status` (String) `Creating`, `Starting`, `Ready`, `Pausing`, `Paused` or `Terminating`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--kube_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kube_config`

Read-Only:

- `client_certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM client certificate to authenticate with.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) The PEM key of `client_certificate`.
- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM CA certificate the api's certificate is signed by.
- `host` (String, Sensitive) The Kubernetes api's url.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) The whole kubeconfig file.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token to authenticate with, when the kubeconfig uses one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A cluster is imported by its id, see `cloider cluster list`
terraform import cloider_cluster.web x8f2kq
```
